def text_value(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    return str(v)

def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", text_value(s).strip().lower())

def is_red_color(color):
    if color is None:
        return False
    if getattr(color, "type", None) == "rgb" and color.rgb:
        rgb = color.rgb.upper()
        return rgb in {"FFFF0000", "00FF0000", "FF0000"}
    return False

def red_runs(cell):

    runs = []
    if v is not None and v.__class__.__name__ == "CellRichText":
        for part in v:

            if font is not None and is_red_color(getattr(font, "color", None)):
